name: Casinos and Gaming
description: Use of casinos, online gaming and betting to convert illicit cash into seemingly legitimate winnings or cheques, to move value between parties, or to obscure its origin through chips, accounts and junkets. Minimal play with high buy-ins is a classic sign.

sources.text: FATF, Vulnerabilities of Casinos and Gaming Sector (2009)
FATF, Guidance on the Risk-Based Approach for Casinos (2008)

indicators.name: Large cash buy-in with minimal gambling
indicators.canon: Large buy-in or deposits with little underlying activity
indicators.desc: Substantial funds are deposited or bought in with minimal gambling or betting activity before withdrawal.
indicators.ctx: Customer buys chips with cash, plays little, and cashes out.

indicators.name: Chips passed between players or taken away
indicators.canon: Chips passed between players or taken away
indicators.desc: Chips transferred between customers or cashed by third parties.
indicators.ctx: Chips transferred between customers or cashed by third parties.

indicators.name: Funds deposited and withdrawn from casino account with little play
indicators.canon: Funds deposited and withdrawn from casino account with little play
indicators.desc: Casino deposit accounts used like bank accounts.
indicators.ctx: Casino deposit accounts used like bank accounts.

indicators.name: Use of multiple identities or accounts
indicators.canon: One person holding multiple identities or accounts
indicators.desc: The same individual appears under different names or opens several accounts or wallets, directly or through an intermediary.
indicators.ctx: Same person plays under different names or accounts.

indicators.name: Third-party funding of play
indicators.canon: Payments from or to unrelated third parties
indicators.desc: Funds are paid or received, or instructions are given to pay, through parties with no evident link to the customer, contract, debt or insured interest. Includes third-party cheques, loan repayments, premiums, gaming funds and goods payments not matching the documentation.
indicators.ctx: Funds from third parties or unusual bank sources pay for play.

indicators.name: Junket or VIP operators moving funds across borders
indicators.canon: Junket or VIP operators moving funds across borders
indicators.desc: Junket arrangements shift large funds without clear play.
indicators.ctx: Junket arrangements shift large funds without clear play.

indicators.name: Online gaming accounts with deposit via multiple cards or wallets
indicators.canon: Online gaming accounts with deposit via multiple cards or wallets
indicators.desc: Multiple payment instruments for an account with low play.
indicators.ctx: Multiple payment instruments for an account with low play.

indicators.name: Winnings claims lacking supporting records
indicators.desc: Requests for win certificates or cheques not matching records.
indicators.ctx: Requests for win certificates or cheques not matching records.

indicators.name: Player collusion or chip-dumping
indicators.desc: Players lose deliberately to a counterpart.
indicators.ctx: Players lose deliberately to a counterpart.
